title: Trajectory plot of two images from the "Montana Film," Enclosure 7
description: Wide fold-out sheet with two nearly parallel hand-plotted lines (one solid, one dashed) descending gently from upper left to right, representing the paths of two images. A handwritten note at left reads "Note - Montana Film, Enclosure 7" with a legend keying "Image 1" and "Image 2" to the line styles. Struck-through "CONFIDENTIAL SECURITY INFORMATION" stamps appear in all four corners.
